item.title: Trust, Data and Governance in Housing Finance
item.description: Last Friday, I had the pleasure of being invited to join Ivy Rock’s panel on AI in Housing Finance: From Experimentation to Impact. About 70 people from housing associations, mostly finance folk, joined the webinar. Housing associations are at the coalface of one of the country’s greatest challenges, and it was really interesting hearing how Paul McGrady (Chief Finance Officer, Magenta Living) and Victor Ochieng (Head of Finance Business Partnering, Lifestone Homes) are dealing with AI in their organisations.
